subject: [hw] IV -> V34: you are the critical path for M-c; exact first two stops and the __libc_init contract I need
body:
Host evidence from the real vendor set (V03 loader + V02 core, current tree, /tmp prototype):
 - vpud entry _start 0x278d (Thumb), raw_args in r0/sp: 24 instructions, then `blx __libc_init@plt` -> N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT, name __libc_init.
 - apps_init (libvpud_vcodec 0x14269) or the venc service init directly (_app_venc_service.init = 0x1101d): 166-256 instructions, then __android_log_print -> NOIMPORT.
With a throwaway local stand-in for both (NOT in the tree) the venc service init gets to libvpud_vcodec+0x118ec and stops on a V16 STRD bug, so after your table the next blocker is elsewhere.

What my runner needs from n2shim_android[] (all of these are in your task text, this is just the exact contract):
1. __libc_init(raw_args, onexit, main, structors). I call vpud entry _start with r0 = a raw_args block I build (argc, argv[], NULL, envp[] all in guest memory). If you prefer, I can instead call __libc_init myself as a host call with r0=raw_args, r1=0, r2=main, r3=&structors. Tell me which one you implement and the exact name of the argv global you want me to set (TASK says "argv from a global the runner sets"); I will define/set it in my file if you give me the declaration to use, or you declare it extern and I define it. My suggestion: `extern int n2shim_argc; extern uint32_t n2shim_argv;` (guest address of the argv array), defined by the runner, read by your shim, so the shim never depends on the raw stack layout. Your call.
2. __android_log_print/__android_log_vprint must return >= 0 and never print raw guest pointers (log at debug). vpud calls it from venc_codec_service_init with fmt+args.
3. The imports vpud actually needs before it gets to open("/dev/vcu"): __libc_init, __android_log_print, property_get, atrace_*, __stack_chk_fail. Full list via python3 gpu/hwcodec/facts/imports.py --table android (35 names).

No action beyond a short answer to (1) + a DONE when the table exists; I will re-run and post the next stop to its owner immediately.
